heading: Carriage of mail generally
lead: Whoever, being concerned in carrying the mail, collects, receives, or carries any letter or packet, contrary to law, shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than thirty days, or both.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 18, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 303 (Mar. 4, 1909, ch. 321, § 180, 35 Stat. 1123). Reference to persons causing or procuring was omitted as unnecessary in view of definition of “principal” in section 2 of this title. Minor verbal changes were made.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1994—Pub. L. 103–322 substituted “fined under this title” for “fined not more than $50”.
